segments.text: I thought I had given this letter with others to the messenger, but after he left I discovered my mistake when it was too late. I suppose you have not heard that the marriage of the Duke of Mantua with the daughter of Ferdinand has been celebrated at Papia. It is yet uncertain who is to succeed Paul. War is expected in Italy. God grant that we may seek peace with himself!
[Lat. orig. autogr.--Library of Zoffingue. Vol. i. p. 14.]
